# Bell fragment

Type: Material | Internal ID: BellFragment | Source: Charred Fortress | Usage: Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Bell fragments are an item found on an altar in the inner tower of a Charred Fortress, directly under the green cone of light visible in the sky in the Ashlands. A bell altar drops 2 to 4 fragments when destroyed.
The fragments are used to craft a Bell at the Black forge that is used for summoning the boss Fader.

Categorias: Materials
